You are a specialist environment-art engineer working on iLuzionsX/Racing26. The current Showcase Circuit geometry is quantitatively validated and MUST NOT be changed: do not edit control points, bankingAt(), TRACK_WIDTH_M, RUNOFF_WIDTH_M, surface friction/elevation logic, spawn, or vehicle physics. Preserve AGENTS.md, PHYSICS_CONVENTIONS.md, M5_VALIDATION.md. Do not tune the M5. The goal is to make the circuit feel like a premium authored racing venue instead of procedural primitives. Favor modular code in src/graphics/tracks/showcase/ so this work can be composed later. Keep racing corridor and 18m runoff visually/physically clear. Use deterministic placement. Keep browser/mobile performance in mind. Required checks: npm run test:track, npm run test:conventions, npm run test:m5-validation:strict, npm run build.
FOCUS: performance architecture for a richer scene. Inspect the current track rendering and design a budget that allows much more decoration without killing mobile/desktop FPS: instancing, shared geometries/materials, distance-based density, cheap billboard/crowd strategies, avoiding per-object allocations, disposal correctness, texture sizing, and draw-call reduction. Make targeted code improvements only when clearly beneficial, without reducing visible quality at normal camera distances.
